items.exampleEn: The film is about a judge whose righteousness made him many enemies.
items.exampleZh: 那部電影講的是一位因為正直而樹敵眾多的法官。

items.exampleEn: She agonized for weeks over which university to choose.
items.exampleZh: 她為了要選哪所大學苦惱了好幾個星期。

items.exampleEn: "Who, me? I didn't touch it," he said innocently.
items.exampleZh: 「誰？我嗎？我沒碰它。」他一臉無辜地說。

items.exampleEn: It was cowardly of him to send an angry message without signing his name.
items.exampleZh: 他寄了一封憤怒的訊息卻不署名，真是懦弱。

items.exampleEn: The singer's strange outfit created a furor online.
items.exampleZh: 那位歌手奇特的服裝在網路上引起一陣騷動。

items.exampleEn: Her mournful face told us the bad news before she spoke.
items.exampleZh: 她還沒開口，悲傷的臉就告訴了我們壞消息。

items.exampleEn: The judges looked impressed after her song.
items.exampleZh: 她唱完歌後，評審們看起來印象深刻。

items.exampleEn: He was irritated by the loud music next door.
items.exampleZh: 隔壁的吵鬧音樂讓他很惱火。

items.sentenceEn: The teacher was impressed by the students' creative ideas.
items.sentenceZh: 老師對學生們富有創意的想法印象深刻。

items.audioEn: I was irritated because the train was late again, so I took a taxi to work.
items.audioZh: 火車又誤點了，我很惱火，所以搭計程車去上班。
items.questionZh: 說話者最後怎麼去上班？

items.sentenceEn: The little girl innocently asked why the sky is blue.
items.sentenceZh: 那個小女孩天真地問為什麼天空是藍色的。

items.sentenceEn: A mournful song played as the old ship left the harbor for the last time.
items.sentenceZh: 那艘老船最後一次駛離港口時，播放著一首哀傷的歌。

items.stemEn: Blaming your little brother for your own mistake is ____.
items.stemZh: 把自己的錯怪到弟弟頭上是懦弱的行為。

items.stemEn: The sudden rise in bus fares caused a ____ across the city.
items.stemZh: 公車票價突然上漲，在全市引起一陣騷動。

items.passageEn: Last month, our school decided to cancel the spring trip, and it caused a furor among the students. Many were irritated, and some wrote letters to show their dissatisfaction. Our principal agonized over the decision for days. In the end, she called a meeting and explained that the bus company had suddenly closed. Everyone was impressed by her honesty, and a group of parents offered to drive the students instead.
items.passageZh: 上個月，學校決定取消春季旅行，在學生之間引起一陣騷動。很多人很惱火，有些人還寫信表達不滿。校長為了這個決定苦惱了好幾天。最後，她召開會議，說明是遊覽車公司突然倒閉了。大家都對她的坦誠印象深刻，還有一群家長主動提議開車載學生去。

questions.questionZh: 學校為什麼取消春季旅行？
最後一群家長做了什麼？
options: 主動提議開車載學生去

items.promptZh: 那位老警察以正直聞名。
referenceEn: The old police officer is famous for his righteousness.
That old police officer is well known for his righteousness.
rubricZh: 要用 righteousness 當名詞（例如 his righteousness）
「以…聞名」可寫，例如 be famous for、be known for 等

items.promptZh: 風吹過那棟老房子時，發出了悲傷的聲音。
referenceEn: The wind made a mournful sound as it blew through the old house.
As the wind blew through the old house, it made a mournful sound.
rubricZh: mournful 可放名詞前或 be 動詞後（例如 a mournful sound、was mournful 等）
「吹過」可寫，例如 blew through、blew past 等
時態可用過去式或現在式（例如 made、makes 等）
